response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with deep breadth (18+ years across web, mobile, embedded) and genuine developer-tools credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, Selenium training). However, this is a Level II people-management role requiring at least 2 years of people management and 3 years of formal technical leadership, and the resume shows no evidence of managing engineers, conducting performance reviews, or leading organizational change. The profile fits a Staff/Senior IC track far better than an engineering management role.
strengths: Authentic developer-tooling experience: built test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD and DevOps infrastructure, and MCP code generators
18+ years of broad software development experience, well above the 8-year minimum, including high-scale low-latency systems
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and code katas, plus some mobile (iOS/Apple TV) experience
concerns: No formal people-management experience — no direct reports, performance management, or hiring responsibility evident
No demonstrated experience leading organizational change or setting team-level roadmaps in a large organization
Career trajectory is consistently IC-focused with frequent role changes; limited evidence of sustained cross-team leadership at scale

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
Deep and broad engineering experience with mentorship track record
